decision_implementation_pipeline.description: THE CORE VALUE. Work the Priority Stack top-to-bottom.
rules: If Michael made a decision → implement NOW. Patch instruction pages, update canon, adjust Backlog priorities, modify protocols.
If Michael corrected something → apply correction across ALL affected pages. One correction = system-wide fix this run.
If Michael touched a canon page → that page is HOT. Audit, extend, cross-reference. Follow Michael's energy.
If a principle was established → verify it's reflected in instructions, canon, and active protocols. Patch now if not.
If none of the above → fall to Export Pipeline: pick next UNMIRRORED page and produce a VAULT artifact.

work_protocol: MINE — search_code all 3 GitHub repos for related content. Pull with get_file_contents.
AUDIT — contradictions, stale references, drift from current state
SYNTHESIZE — merge Notion + GitHub sources. Richest version wins.
BUILD — fill holes, draft missing content, apply patches (<5 lines in-place)
EXPORT — create_or_update_file to push clean markdown to GitHub. THIS IS the artifact.
UPDATE export state — mark page MIRRORED/SYNCED/ENRICHED in Canon Access Index
CROSS-REFERENCE — close related Backlog items, update indexes
ACT on findings: missing Backlog items → create. Significant findings → Build Log entry.

hard_rules: Every run is a full cycle. SCAN → BUILD → SHIP → LOG. No phase skipped.
Platform Death Test is mandatory. No commit SHA = FAIL.
Artifact-first. Value = what survives on GitHub.
Export before log. GitHub artifact ships in Phase 3, Notion state updates in Phase 4.
Cross-repo mining is not optional. Notion-only audits are v4 thinking.
Build, don't just scout. Every run produces tangible output. Scout-only = C grade at best.
One Build Log DB entry per run.
One pulse-incarnation cycle at a time.
Keep runtime tight — halt fail-closed if vector can't finish cleanly.
Prior worker audit failure → fix BEFORE BUILD phase.
Compound over time. Each run leaves system measurably smarter.
Anticipate, don't just react. Use signal patterns to predict Michael's next focus.
Self-bootstrapping repo. Every SEED makes rebuild from GitHub alone possible.
Web/site health checks out of scope (no HTTP ping tool).

what_to_extract: Raw quotes — Michael's exact words, verbatim. Tag with signal strength.
Decisions — choices that set direction, with canon impact mapping
New principles — any law, rule, or operating standard established
New commands or protocols — anything Michael invented or named
Corrections — where Michael corrected agent behavior. Flag if instruction page needs updating.
System design insights — architecture, structure, process ideas
Emotional signal — frustration = broken, excitement = engaged, urgency = move faster
what_to_exclude: Content Michael pasted from external sources (Gemini dumps, etc.)
execution_steps: 1. Extract all qualifying content by 12-section schema
2. Preserve Michael's exact words — verbatim-first always
3. Self-grade: A/B/C/F. Dense session + thin extraction = honest low grade.
4. Contradiction check vs last 3 reincarnation entries. Flag conflicts.
5. Create child page under Reincarnation Log in Notion
7. Verify GitHub push — confirm commit SHA. If fail, retry once, then GITHUB_PUBLISH_FAILED.
8. Update Navigator Index with new entry (Notion URL + GitHub path)
9. BRIDGE TO PULSE (MANDATORY) — ALL decisions/corrections/principles → Handoff Ledger as REINCARNATION_SIGNAL with 🔴/🟡/🟢 tags. Update Living Reincarnation State.
10. Confirm to Michael: quote count, decision count, correction count, grade, fingerprint
post_extract_actions: Correction flagged 'Instruction Update: Y' → patch instruction page immediately
Trivial unfinished action (<5 min) → do it now before confirming
Answerable open question → answer in the entry
Stage work for next session → STAGED_FOR_SESSION items to Handoff Ledger
Set active_mission if Michael defined explicit pipeline/overnight work
